evidence.quote: Windows 11 is a client operating system and includes features that organizations should know about.
Windows 11 offers innovations focused on enhancing end-user productivity, and is designed to support today's hybrid work environment.

Includes both Microsoft 365 Apps for enterprise, the latest Office apps for your PC and Mac (such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and others), and a full suite of online services for email, file storage and collaboration, meetings, and more.
Learn how to build and manage powerful applications using Microsoft Azure services. Get documentation, example code, tutorials, and more.

Browse Azure products Popular AI + Machine Learning Analytics Compute Containers Databases Developer Tools DevOps Hybrid + multicloud Identity Integration Internet of Things Management and Governance Media Migration Mixed Reality Mobile Networking Security Storage Virtual Desktop Infrastructure Web
Microsoft Copilot Chat is a secure AI chat experience available to eligible Microsoft 365 users.

It combines large language models (LLMs), enterprise-grade protections, and grounding from web data and, in specific contexts , organizational data to help users find information, create content, and complete tasks.
The information available to Copilot Chat depends on where users access Copilot Chat and whether they have a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.
This means it's subject to service capacity availability to ensure the product works well for everyone.

claims.wording: Windows 11 is the client operating-system layer for PC experience and user productivity.
Microsoft 365 combines Office apps with online services for email, file storage, collaboration and meetings.
Azure is the cloud-services layer for building and managing applications, including AI, compute and storage categories.
Copilot Chat provides AI assistance to eligible Microsoft 365 users for information, content and tasks.
Copilot capability and grounding depend on access point, service capacity and Microsoft 365 Copilot licensing.
The selected sources describe separate product layers: Windows, Microsoft 365, Azure and Copilot Chat.

knownGaps: The selected public sources do not enumerate every Microsoft product family, SKU, region, preview or tenant configuration.
The package does not verify a specific organization's license assignments, admin settings, data residency requirements or procurement entitlements.
Azure evidence comes from the documentation hub and category listing; service-level architecture, pricing, limits and SLAs require separate confirmation.
Copilot evidence is scoped to Copilot Chat and Microsoft 365 licensing context; other Copilot-branded products may have different requirements.
